measurement.label: Productive compute share

measurement.label: Compute (PFLOP/s)
measurement.subject: All modeled GPU racks
measurement.definition: Modeled average since start: peak cluster compute × productive compute share × pipeline non-bubble fraction × thermal clock fraction.
measurement.context: Now: 1 computing · 0 communicating · 31 waiting. Cyan/green: compute · Violet: transfer · Amber: waiting.
